items.title: The hole in OpenSSH - Password Bypass in Plain Sight
items.summary: From hacked French refrigerators igniting fires to a massive OpenSSH authentication bug hiding in plain sight for a decade, this week’s stories expose how lapses in basic security ripple into chaos—and why AI is now both a weapon and shield. • TA surprising announcement regarding SpinRite. • What is being "AI-pilled" and how does it happen. • OpenAI just released GPT-6 Cyber. What does that mean. • An irresponsible hacker published 30+ N-Able 0-days. • 700 French refrigerators hacked. What's next. • Lots of listener feedback about the Cloudflare tunneling solution, Voyager 1, true hardware drive encryption, the random number 4 and the amount of debris in orbit • Then we look at a 10-year old serious SSH authentication bug (that's kinda wonderful) Show Notes - https://www.grc.com/sn/SN-1104-Notes.pdf Hosts: Steve Gibson and Leo Laporte Security Now episode 1104 More Info: https://twit.tv/shows/security-now/episodes/1104 Sponsors: • http://guardsquare.com • http://trustedtech.team/twit • http://originhq.com/securitynow • http://joindeleteme.com/twit-biz Download or subscribe to Security Now at https://twit.tv/shows/security-now You can submit a question to Security Now at the GRC Feedback Page.
